title: Last Rites
summary: Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember says nobody said the last rites for the dead in the Sunken Chapel, where the legion was bound. Hold its nave while they're said, and she'll teach your clerics a blessing (the cleric's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Go to the Sunken Chapel, in the marsh where the river leaves the Vale, and hold the last hall of the Nave, its first floor, for five waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Nave's last hall

ready: Go back to Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: Ilse taught your clerics Bless: the rites said forward, for the living, which she says is the only direction that helps.
